section_previews_by_key.12:prayer: Father, thank You for speaking clearly in Genesis 2:21-25. In this passage You bring faithful response to God's word into the open through The Lord God caused a deep sleep to fall upon the man. Lord, keep us from reading these words as distant history only, and press them into our ordinary obedience today. Where we resist the truth highlighted in this reflection, bring repentance and renewed trust. Keep us near Your word, and do not let ordinary pressure turn us away from humble obedience. Holy Spirit, take what we have seen in the exposition and turn it into worship instead of mere information. Teach us to remember that Genesis 2:21-25 opens with a scene marked by faithful response to God's word. Guard our speech from haste, our work from pride, and our choices from whatever would pull us away from costly worship instead of cautious self-protection. Help us practice the obedience this day requires with humility as we pursue concrete obedience under the authority of the passage. Amen.
